title: Speed at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v_B = 10 m/s using energy conservation from A to B.

title: Speed at first collision
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v_C = 9 m/s using energy conservation with friction from B to C.

title: Number of collisions
description: Essential: Correctly determines n = 3 by analyzing total travel distance before stopping.

title: Final rest position
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the final stopping distance from B as 7 m.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem correctly for frictionless and frictional segments.

title: Friction work calculation
description: Important: Correctly computes work done by friction as μmg × distance for each pass.

title: Collision distance analysis
description: Important: Recognizes that each round trip between B and C covers 2×9.5 m after the first collision.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s) throughout calculations.

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for friction work in energy equations (should be negative).

title: Collision count mistake
description: Pitfall: Miscounts collisions by misunderstanding the travel pattern or final partial trip.
